definitions.explanation: The space or gap between two things or people.
A period of time during which something happens.
The relationship or connection between parties.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}とあなたの{間|あいだ}。
{駅|えき}と{学校|がっこう}の{間|あいだ}に{公園|こうえん}がある。
examples.english: There's a park between the station and the school.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}と{壁|かべ}の{間|あいだ}に{本|ほん}が{落|お}ちていた。
examples.english: A book had fallen between the desk and the wall.

examples.japanese: {木|き}と{木|き}の{間|あいだ}から{海|うみ}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: You can see the ocean through the gap between the trees.

examples.japanese: {本棚|ほんだな}と{壁|かべ}の{間|あいだ}に{猫|ねこ}が{隠|かく}れていたので、{見|み}つけるのに{時間|じかん}がかかりました。
examples.english: The cat was hiding between the bookshelf and the wall, so it took time to find it.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}の{間|あいだ}、{静|しず}かにしてください。
{寝|ね}ている{間|あいだ}に{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}った。
examples.english: It rained while I was sleeping.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みの{間|あいだ}、{毎日|まいにち}{泳|およ}ぎました。
examples.english: I swam every day during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}っている{間|あいだ}、{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいました。
examples.english: I was reading a book while riding the train.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{間|あいだ}は{携帯|けいたい}の{電源|でんげん}をお{切|き}りください。ご{協力|きょうりょく}よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please turn off your mobile phone during the meeting. Thank you for your cooperation.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{間|あいだ}に{何|なに}かあったの？
examples.english: Did something happen between you two?

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}との{間|あいだ}が{悪|わる}くなった。
examples.english: Things got bad between me and my friend.

examples.japanese: {親子|おやこ}の{間|あいだ}には{信頼|しんらい}が{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: Trust is important between parents and children.

examples.japanese: {国|くに}と{国|くに}の{間|あいだ}で{話|はな}し{合|あ}いが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Discussions have begun between the countries.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}と{学生|がくせい}の{間|あいだ}では{敬語|けいご}を{使|つか}うのが{普通|ふつう}ですが、{最近|さいきん}は{変|か}わってきています。
examples.english: It's normal to use polite language between teachers and students, but this has been changing recently.

notes: {間|あいだ} is very versatile. For space, use AとBの{間|あいだ} (between A and B). For time, use [noun/verb]の{間|あいだ} (during/while). Note the different reading: {間|かん} is used in compounds like {時間|じかん} (time) and {人間|にんげん} (human being).
